title: TLS 1.3 is designed to prevent eavesdropping, tampering, and message forgery
summary: TLS 1.3 is designed to prevent eavesdropping, tampering, and message forgery.
body: RFC 8446 specifies version 1.3 of the Transport Layer Security protocol and says TLS allows client and server applications to communicate over the Internet in a way designed to prevent eavesdropping, tampering, and message forgery. The source says: "TLS allows client/server applications to communicate over the Internet in a way that is designed to prevent eavesdropping, tampering, and message forgery." The sentence is the design goal of the protocol. It is not a guarantee about every configuration, every certificate, or every application that can be reached through TLS. The RFC obsoletes the TLS 1.2 specification, RFC 5246.

sources.title: RFC 8446: The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3
